description: This file defines the abstract class RenderProblem and its nested classes, representing layout rendering errors in Android Studio, including methods for creating and managing error messages with different severities and formats.

classes.name: RenderProblem
classes.description: Abstract class representing a layout rendering error, with methods for creating, comparing, and formatting error messages.

classes.name: RenderProblem.Plain
classes.description: Concrete subclass representing a plain text render problem.

classes.name: RenderProblem.Html
classes.description: Concrete subclass representing a render problem with HTML content, using HtmlBuilder.

classes.name: RenderProblem.Deferred
classes.description: Subclass for lazily computed render problems, generating HTML when needed.

methods.name: createPlain
methods.description: Creates a RenderProblem with plain text message and severity.

methods.name: createPlain
methods.description: Creates a RenderProblem with message, severity, project, link manager, and optional throwable, including a link to error details.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an empty HTML RenderProblem for appending content.

methods.name: createDeferred
methods.description: Creates a lazily evaluated RenderProblem with severity, tag, text, and throwable.

methods.name: throwable
methods.description: Sets the throwable associated with the RenderProblem.

methods.name: priority
methods.description: Sets the priority level of the RenderProblem.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Sets the tag for the RenderProblem.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Returns the HTML representation of the RenderProblem.

methods.name: appendHtml
methods.description: Appends the HTML of the RenderProblem to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares RenderProblems based on severity, priority, and ordinal.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a list of RenderProblems into a single HTML string.

methods.name: getSeverity
methods.description: Returns the severity level of the RenderProblem.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the associated Throwable, if any.
